Is "active season" server-side or client-side? **Server-side, derived by date — no `active`/`isActive` boolean column.** **`apps/worker/src/repositories/season-repository.ts`** ```ts 127: export const findActive = async ({ db, leagueId }: { db: DrizzleDB; leagueId: string }) => { 128: const now = new Date(); 129: const [comp] = await db 130: .select(getTableColumns(season)) 131: .from(season) 132: .innerJoin(organization, eq(organization.id, season.leagueId)) 133: .where( 134: and( 135: eq(season.leagueId, leagueId), 136: eq(season.closed, false), 137: lt(season.startDate, now), 138: or(isNull(season.endDate), gt(season.endDate, now)) 139: ) 140: ); 141: return comp ?? null; 142: }; 143: 144: export const findAllActive = async ({ db, leagueId }: { db: DrizzleDB; leagueId: string }) => { 145: const now = new Date(); 146: return db 147: .select(getTableColumns(season)) 148: .from(season) 149: .innerJoin(organization, eq(organization.id, season.leagueId)) 150: .where(and( 151: eq(season.leagueId, leagueId), 152: eq(season.closed, false), 153: lt(season.startDate, now), 154: or(isNull(season.endDate), gt(season.endDate, now)) 155: )) 158: .orderBy(desc(season.startDate)); 159: }; ``` So "active" = `closed = false` AND `startDate < now` AND (`endDate IS NULL` OR `endDate > now`). The schema exposes only `closed` and `archived` booleans. The client re-derives a display status (`active | upcoming | ended | locked | archived`) in `getSeasonStatus` (`seasons/index.tsx:47-58`) for the seasons list, but the **default-screen redirect relies on the server-side date-based `findActive`**. Note: `findActive` returns the first matching row with no explicit ordering — if multiple seasons overlap date-wise, it's effectively arbitrary (typically the oldest-inserted since SQLite returns in rowid order). A mobile home screen that calls `findActive` will get the same behavior. If you want the *most recent* active season, `findAllActive` orders by `startDate DESC` (line 158).
